mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, balance_amount, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, balance_amount, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, user_id, balance_amount, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet WHERE id = #{walletId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT w.id AS wallet_id, w.balance_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(a2.balance) FROM wallet_account wa2 INNER JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = wa2.account_id AND a2.user_id = w.user_id AND a2.is_deleted = 0 AND a2.is_active = TRUE WHERE wa2.wallet_id = w.id AND wa2.status = 'LINKED' ), 0) AS total_linked_account_balance, COALESCE(( SELECT t.total_target_amount FROM trips t WHERE t.user_id = w.user_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING') ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.start_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.start_date, t.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(wl.amount) FROM wallet_ledger wl WHERE wl.wallet_id = w.id AND wl.direction = 'IN' AND wl.transaction_type = 'CHARGE' AND wl.transfer_method = 'MANUAL' AND wl.created_at >= COALESCE(( SELECT active_trip.start_date FROM trips active_trip WHERE active_trip.user_id = w.user_id AND active_trip.status IN ('TRAVELING', 'ENDED') AND active_trip.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY active_trip.start_date DESC, active_trip.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), CURRENT_DATE) ), 0) AS external_charge_amount, GREATEST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(tx.amount) FROM transactions tx INNER JOIN trips active_trip ON active_trip.id = tx.trip_id WHERE active_trip.user_id = w.user_id AND active_trip.status IN ('TRAVELING', 'ENDED') AND active_trip.is_deleted = 0 AND active_trip.id = ( SELECT latest_trip.id FROM trips latest_trip WHERE latest_trip.user_id = w.user_id AND latest_trip.status IN ('TRAVELING', 'ENDED') AND latest_trip.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest_trip.start_date DESC, latest_trip.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND tx.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND tx.is_deleted = 0 ), 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT t.total_target_amount FROM trips t WHERE t.user_id = w.user_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0), 0) AS over_target_spent_amount, a.id AS account_id, a.account_name AS account_name, COALESCE(si.institution_name, cci.organization_name, '연동 계좌') AS bank_name, CASE WHEN a.account_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('****', RIGHT(a.account_number, 4)) END AS masked_account_number FROM wallet w LEFT JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.wallet_id = w.id AND wa.is_primary = TRUE AND wa.status = 'LINKED' LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = wa.account_id AND a.user_id = w.user_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN codef_connected_institutions cci ON cci.codef_connection_id = a.codef_connection_id AND cci.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN supported_institutions si ON si.organization_code = cci.organization_code AND si.is_active = TRUE WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

WITH RECURSIVE month_range AS ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(month_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM month_range WHERE month_start < CAST(DATE_FORMAT(#{today}, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mr.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN wl.direction = 'IN' THEN wl.amount WHEN wl.direction = 'OUT' THEN -wl.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS saved_amount, CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(mr.month_start, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{today}, '%Y-%m') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS current_month, TRUE AS available FROM month_range mr LEFT JOIN wallet_ledger wl ON wl.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wl.transaction_type != 'ADJUST' AND wl.trip_id = ( SELECT id FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND DATE_FORMAT(wl.created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(mr.month_start, '%Y-%m') AND DATE(wl.created_at) <= #{today} GROUP BY mr.month_start ORDER BY mr.month_start

SELECT #{month} AS month, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS saved_amount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS charge_amount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS withdraw_amount FROM wallet_ledger WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND transaction_type != 'ADJUST' AND trip_id = ( SELECT id FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{month}

SELECT wl.id AS ledger_id, wl.direction, wl.transaction_type, wl.transfer_method, wl.amount, wl.balance_before, wl.balance_after, wl.memo, wl.created_at, COALESCE( acc.account_name, wtc.card_name, CONCAT(wr.bank_name, ' ****', RIGHT(wr.account_number, 4)) ) AS account_name, wct.currency_code FROM wallet_ledger wl LEFT JOIN accounts acc ON acc.id = CASE WHEN wl.source_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN wl.source_id WHEN wl.target_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN wl.target_id END LEFT JOIN wallet_travel_card wtc ON wtc.id = CASE WHEN wl.source_type = 'TRAVEL_CARD' THEN wl.source_id WHEN wl.target_type = 'TRAVEL_CARD' THEN wl.target_id END LEFT JOIN wallet_withdraw_recipient wr ON wl.target_type = 'RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT' AND wr.id = wl.target_id LEFT JOIN wallet_card_topup wct ON wct.wallet_ledger_id = wl.id WHERE wl.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND DATE_FORMAT(wl.created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ORDER BY wl.created_at DESC, wl.id DESC

SELECT TRUE AS linked, wtc.id AS wallet_travel_card_id, wtc.user_travel_card_id, wtc.travel_card_id, wtc.card_name, wtc.issuer_name, wtc.masked_card_number FROM wallet_travel_card wtc WHERE wtc.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wtc.status = 'LINKED' ORDER BY wtc.linked_at DESC, wtc.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tcb.currency_code, c.currency_name, c.symbol, tcb.balance_amount, tcb.krw_estimated_amount FROM travel_card_balance tcb INNER JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = tcb.currency_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT currency_code, MAX(created_at) AS last_ledger_at FROM travel_card_ledger WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} GROUP BY currency_code ) latest ON latest.currency_code = tcb.currency_code WHERE tcb.wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND tcb.balance_amount > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(latest.last_ledger_at, tcb.updated_at) DESC, tcb.updated_at DESC, tcb.id DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT tcb.currency_code, c.currency_name, c.symbol, tcb.balance_amount, tcb.krw_estimated_amount FROM travel_card_balance tcb INNER JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = tcb.currency_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT currency_code, MAX(created_at) AS last_ledger_at FROM travel_card_ledger WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} GROUP BY currency_code ) latest ON latest.currency_code = tcb.currency_code WHERE tcb.wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND tcb.balance_amount > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(latest.last_ledger_at, tcb.updated_at) DESC, tcb.updated_at DESC, tcb.currency_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet ( user_id, balance_amount, status, version ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{balanceAmount}, #{status}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_cards WHERE id = #{travelCardId} AND is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = 0 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_account ( wallet_id, account_id, is_primary, status ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{accountId}, #{isPrimary}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary = VALUES(is_primary), status = 'LINKED', unlinked_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_account SET status = 'UNLINKED', is_primary = FALSE, unlinked_at = NOW() WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'LINKED'
UPDATE wallet_account SET is_primary = FALSE WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED'
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, COALESCE(si.institution_name, '연동 계좌') AS bank_name, a.account_name, CASE WHEN a.account_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('****', RIGHT(a.account_number, 4)) END AS masked_account_number, a.balance, a.withdrawable_amount, CASE WHEN wa.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS linked, COALESCE(wa.is_primary, FALSE) AS primary_account FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN wallet w ON w.user_id = a.user_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.wallet_id = w.id AND wa.account_id = a.id AND wa.status = 'LINKED' LEFT JOIN supported_institutions si ON si.organization_code = a.organization_code AND si.is_active = TRUE WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_active = TRUE AND wa.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY linked DESC, primary_account DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS account_id, COALESCE(si.institution_name, '등록 계좌') AS bank_name, a.account_name, CASE WHEN a.account_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('****', RIGHT(a.account_number, 4)) END AS masked_account_number, a.balance, a.withdrawable_amount, FALSE AS linked, FALSE AS primary_account FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN wallet w ON w.user_id = a.user_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.wallet_id = w.id AND wa.account_id = a.id AND wa.status = 'LINKED' LEFT JOIN supported_institutions si ON si.organization_code = a.organization_code AND si.is_active = TRUE WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_active = TRUE AND wa.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS account_id, COALESCE(si.institution_name, '등록 계좌') AS bank_name, a.account_name, CONCAT('****', RIGHT(a.account_number, 4)) AS masked_account_number, a.balance, a.withdrawable_amount, CASE WHEN wa.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS linked, COALESCE(wa.is_primary, FALSE) AS primary_account FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN wallet w ON w.user_id = a.user_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.wallet_id = w.id AND wa.account_id = a.id AND wa.status = 'LINKED' LEFT JOIN supported_institutions si ON si.organization_code = a.organization_code AND si.is_active = TRUE WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY primary_account DESC, linked DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_withdraw_recipient (user_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_holder_name, last_used_at, use_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolderName}, NOW(), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), bank_name = VALUES(bank_name), account_holder_name = VALUES(account_holder_name), last_used_at = NOW(), use_count = use_count + 1, is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id AS recipient_id, bank_code, bank_name, CONCAT('****', RIGHT(account_number, 4)) AS masked_account_number, account_holder_name, last_used_at, use_count FROM wallet_withdraw_recipient WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY last_used_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT id, user_id, bank_code, bank_name, account_number, account_holder_name, last_used_at, use_count FROM wallet_withdraw_recipient WHERE id = #{recipientId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_name, a.balance, a.withdrawable_amount FROM wallet_account wa JOIN accounts a ON a.id = wa.account_id WHERE wa.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND wa.is_primary = TRUE AND wa.status = 'LINKED' AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET balance = COALESCE(balance, 0) + #{amount}, withdrawable_amount = COALESCE(withdrawable_amount, 0) + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{accountId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_type, transaction_region, amount, balance_after, merchant_name, external_key) VALUES (#{accountId}, CURDATE(), CURTIME(), #{transactionType}, 'DOMESTIC', #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{merchantName}, #{externalKey})

INSERT INTO wallet_ledger ( wallet_id, trip_id, direction, transaction_type, transfer_method, amount, balance_before, balance_after, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, idempotency_key, memo ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{tripId}, #{direction}, #{transactionType}, #{transferMethod}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, wallet_id, direction, transaction_type, transfer_method, amount, balance_before, balance_after, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, idempotency_key, memo, created_at FROM wallet_ledger WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT wl.id AS ledger_id, wl.direction, wl.transaction_type, wl.transfer_method, wl.amount, wl.balance_before, wl.balance_after, wl.memo, wl.created_at, COALESCE( acc.account_name, wtc.card_name, CONCAT(wr.bank_name, ' ****', RIGHT(wr.account_number, 4)) ) AS account_name, wct.currency_code FROM wallet_ledger wl LEFT JOIN accounts acc ON acc.id = CASE WHEN wl.source_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN wl.source_id WHEN wl.target_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN wl.target_id END LEFT JOIN wallet_travel_card wtc ON wtc.id = CASE WHEN wl.source_type = 'TRAVEL_CARD' THEN wl.source_id WHEN wl.target_type = 'TRAVEL_CARD' THEN wl.target_id END LEFT JOIN wallet_withdraw_recipient wr ON wl.target_type = 'RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT' AND wr.id = wl.target_id LEFT JOIN wallet_card_topup wct ON wct.wallet_ledger_id = wl.id WHERE wl.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY wl.created_at DESC, wl.id DESC
SELECT id, wallet_id, source_account_id, amount, day_of_month, enabled, next_transfer_date, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet_auto_saving_rule WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId}

SELECT id, wallet_id, source_account_id, amount, day_of_month, enabled, next_transfer_date, created_at, updated_at FROM wallet_auto_saving_rule WHERE enabled = TRUE AND next_transfer_date IS NOT NULL AND next_transfer_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY next_transfer_date ASC, id ASC

SELECT wasr.id, wasr.source_account_id, a.account_name AS source_account_name, wasr.amount, wasr.day_of_month, wasr.enabled, wasr.next_transfer_date FROM wallet_auto_saving_rule wasr INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.id = wasr.source_account_id WHERE wasr.wallet_id = #{walletId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_auto_saving_rule ( wallet_id, source_account_id, amount, day_of_month, enabled, next_transfer_date ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{amount}, #{dayOfMonth}, #{enabled}, #{nextTransferDate} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_account_id = VALUES(source_account_id), amount = VALUES(amount), day_of_month = VALUES(day_of_month), enabled = VALUES(enabled), next_transfer_date = VALUES(next_transfer_date), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_auto_saving_rule SET next_transfer_date = #{nextTransferDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS wallet_travel_card_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED' ORDER BY linked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, wallet_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status, linked_at, unlinked_at FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED' ORDER BY linked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, wallet_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status, linked_at, unlinked_at FROM wallet_travel_card WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND status = 'LINKED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_travel_card ( wallet_id, travel_card_id, card_name, issuer_name, masked_card_number, status ) SELECT #{walletId}, tc.id, tc.card_name, tc.card_company, #{maskedCardNumber}, #{status} FROM travel_cards tc WHERE tc.id = #{travelCardId} AND tc.is_active = TRUE AND tc.is_deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_name = VALUES(card_name), issuer_name = VALUES(issuer_name), masked_card_number = VALUES(masked_card_number), status = 'LINKED', unlinked_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_travel_card SET status = 'UNLINKED', unlinked_at = NOW() WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND status = 'LINKED'
mapper.select: SELECT currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount FROM travel_card_balance WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} ORDER BY currency_code

SELECT id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount, updated_at FROM travel_card_balance WHERE wallet_travel_card_id = #{walletTravelCardId} AND currency_code = #{currencyCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_card_balance ( wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, balance_amount, krw_estimated_amount ) VALUES ( #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{balanceAmount}, #{krwEstimatedAmount} )

INSERT INTO travel_card_ledger ( wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, direction, transaction_type, foreign_amount, balance_before, balance_after, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, idempotency_key, memo ) VALUES ( #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{direction}, #{transactionType}, #{foreignAmount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{memo} )

INSERT INTO wallet_card_topup ( wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, krw_amount, foreign_amount, status, idempotency_key, external_transaction_id, retry_count, last_tried_at, completed_at, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id, refunded ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{krwAmount}, #{foreignAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalTransactionId}, #{retryCount}, #{lastTriedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{walletLedgerId}, #{cardLedgerId}, #{refunded} )

INSERT INTO wallet_exchange_transaction ( wallet_id, wallet_travel_card_id, currency_code, exchange_type, krw_amount, foreign_amount, base_exchange_rate, applied_exchange_rate, fee_rate, fee_amount, status, completed_at, wallet_ledger_id, card_ledger_id ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{walletTravelCardId}, #{currencyCode}, #{exchangeType}, #{krwAmount}, #{foreignAmount}, #{baseExchangeRate}, #{appliedExchangeRate}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{status}, #{completedAt}, #{walletLedgerId}, #{cardLedgerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT er.deal_base_rate FROM exchange_rates er INNER JOIN currencies c ON c.id = er.target_currency_id WHERE c.currency_code = #{currencyCode} ORDER BY er.rate_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_auto_saving_logs ( wallet_id, status, amount, reason ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{status}, #{amount}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, amount, reason, executed_at FROM wallet_auto_saving_logs WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY executed_at DESC

SELECT t.id AS tripId, w.id AS walletId, COALESCE(w.balance_amount, 0) AS walletBalance, t.total_target_amount AS targetAmount, COALESCE(t.initial_wallet_balance, 0) AS initialWalletBalance, COALESCE(t.emergency_amount, 0) AS emergencyAmount, COALESCE(t.external_charge_amount, 0) AS externalChargedAmount, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(tr.amount) FROM transactions tr WHERE tr.trip_id = t.id AND tr.is_deleted = 0), 0 ) AS totalTripSpentAmount, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(wl.amount) FROM wallet_ledger wl WHERE wl.wallet_id = w.id AND wl.direction = 'IN' AND wl.transaction_type = 'CHARGE' AND wl.created_at >= t.start_date AND wl.created_at <= DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), 0 ) AS travelPeriodChargeAmount FROM trips t LEFT JOIN wallet w ON t.user_id = w.user_id WHERE t.id = #{tripId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0
